- Every module, profile and document summary went through a second, independent fact-check against the source text.

obligations.md: Discuss any planned VA activity with the HKMA before launch. [S:642680fa4467, p.5]
As an RI, notify the SFC and HKMA when intending to start or change VA dealing, advice or asset management, including a change of client type. [S:8934af8cc884, para 5.6]
Classify cryptoasset exposures under Part 12 of the Banking (Capital) Rules, reading CRP-1 alongside, from 1 January 2026. [S:b7d630146e6c, paras 1.1.4, 1.4.1]
Set prudent VA exposure limits and conservative loan-to-value ratios for VA collateral. [S:642680fa4467, p.3]
Keep client digital assets held in custody segregated from the bank's own assets. [S:ce05e67bcdce, para 6]
Notify the HKMA on acquiring any new type of cryptoasset. [S:b7d630146e6c, para 2.1.2]
Discuss custody plans with the HKMA before offering custody. [S:ed61d7c335e7, Implementation, p.2]
For VA dealing, route business only through SFC-licensed VATPs. [S:8a016a912528, para 17]
Check a VATP's status on the SFC's licensed list, not the applicant list. [S:b14be2203d39, applicant section]
Check a stablecoin issuer against the HKMA register, which the HKMA says holds the latest list of licensees. [S:afb6cd0da6ff, paras 4-5]
Read *should* in the HKMA AML Guideline as mandatory, not optional. [S:7bfdad704174, para 1.6]
Where CRP-1 and the BCR differ, follow the BCR; Part 12 of the BCR sets the classification principles. [S:b7d630146e6c, para 1.1.4]
Reflect the 3 June 2026 clarification of CRP-1 para 2.6.4, which took effect immediately. [S:dca53ff0a62c, p.1, paras 3-4]
Keep a regulatory inventory that records each document's classification and supersession, e.g. the 2024 custody circular replaced by the 2026 letter. [S:ed61d7c335e7, Implementation, p.2]
Track commencement dates separately from passage dates (e.g. AMLO amendments: passed December 2022, relevant changes from 1 June 2023). [S:b12bd88c7aee, letter, pp.1-2]

The dealing conclusions encourage firms in, or planning, VA dealing to contact the SFC or HKMA (as applicable) early, e.g. to start pre-application; firms that do not will have to stop operating on commencement. [S:6186c01c6649, paras 33-34]

Tell a formally licensed VATP apart from an applicant or a deemed-to-be-licensed applicant; the SFC keeps them on separate lists (last updated 29 May 2026). [S:b14be2203d39, List of VATP applicants; Last update]
Have the board oversee and endorse a formal strategic business plan addressing DLT and related technology within six months of 9 March 2026. [S:3ec5b269b5dc, letter body, p.2]

Track the 2026 bill target for digital-asset dealing and custody licensing. PS 2.0 proposes the SFC as lead licensing and registration authority, with the HKMA as frontline regulator for banks. [S:654fa5eba8cf, para 104]; [S:a29b51bffc6b, paras 5-6]
Track the start dates proposed in the CARF bill: 1 Jan 2027 for the CARF part and 1 Jan 2028 for the amended CRS part. [S:e8c0a71f0cc5, Clause 1(3)-(4)]
Discuss any new digital-asset activity with the HKMA before launch, as the March 2026 circular restates. [S:3ec5b269b5dc, letter body, p.2]
Be ready to submit the business plan via the HKMA Survey Tool if invited. [S:3ec5b269b5dc, letter body, p.2]
None set by the policy documents in this module; see B2 and B3 for the current rules.
Hold SFC registration for each regulated activity carried on, with at least two HKMA-consented executive officers per activity. [S:8934af8cc884, paras 2.2.1, 2.2.4]
Register relevant individuals on the HKMA Register before they start. [S:8934af8cc884, paras 4.3.1, 4.3.5]
Apply the HKMA AML/CFT Guideline bank-wide; for the RI and any associated entities that are AIs, also have regard to SFC AML/CFT guideline Chapter 12. [S:7bfdad704174, footnote 1]
If the bank is locally incorporated, make sure its subsidiaries that provide digital-asset custody, or staking from custody, meet the HKMA standards. [S:ed61d7c335e7, p.2]; [S:4641e6c404d2, p.1]
Map every digital-asset activity to its entity and capacity (AI, RI, LC subsidiary, associated entity) before applying a circular. [S:a0bd48559762, footnote 3, p.2]
Keep the relevant-individual database current; notify Register changes and specified fitness information within 7 business days. [S:8934af8cc884, paras 4.3.3, 4.3.6, 5.5]
Notify the SFC and HKMA before starting or changing VA activities. [S:8934af8cc884, para 5.6]
Notify the HKMA in advance of an intended SFC registration application. [S:8934af8cc884, para 2.2.3]
Consider early pre-application contact with the SFC or HKMA for the coming dealing regime, which the conclusions encourage. [S:6186c01c6649, para 33]
Confirm a stablecoin issuer counterparty is on the HKMA register. [S:270f1f7324ab, Register note]
Confirm VA dealing partners are SFC-licensed VATPs or, for Relevant Stablecoins only, the HKMA-licensed issuer of that coin. [S:8a016a912528, para 17]; [S:a0bd48559762, para (1), p.3]
Discuss each new VA product or service with the HKMA and obtain its feedback on risk controls before launch. [S:642680fa4467, p.5]
Have the board oversee and endorse the strategic business plan the March 2026 circular asks for. [S:3ec5b269b5dc, letter body, para 4]
Get the MA's written consent for each RI executive officer, applying through the HKMA. [S:8934af8cc884, para 2.2.4]
Track the changes that trigger prior notice: client type, first VA deposits or withdrawals, first staking, first VA-funded subscriptions, other material changes. [S:b79266f3da51, para 10]
If the bank already offers custody, review and revise controls against the 2026 Annex. [S:ed61d7c335e7, Implementation, p.2]

If a cryptoasset with an HKMA-agreed Group 1a, 1b or 2a classification stops meeting the conditions, move it to Group 2b at once; any later move to another group needs HKMA agreement. [S:b7d630146e6c, paras 2.1.3, 2.1.5]
Tokenised products, custody, staking: discuss with the HKMA in advance. [S:b2719f3dcb37, p.6]; [S:ed61d7c335e7, p.2]; [S:4641e6c404d2, p.3]
RI VA activities and changes: notify the SFC and the HKMA in advance. [S:8934af8cc884, para 5.6]; [S:8a016a912528, para 31]
Relevant Stablecoin activities: RIs notify the HKMA and SFC; all AIs discuss with the HKMA. [S:a0bd48559762, p.9]; [S:1babdb609fc8, p.2]
New cryptoasset type: notify the HKMA on acquisition. [S:b7d630146e6c, para 2.1.2]
Equity-like token stakes at or above 5% of Tier 1: seek consent; other significant acquisitions: give at least one month's notice. [S:13365a31e794, paras 1.1, 2.9.1]

Do not treat a firm's sandbox status as a licence; check the HKMA's Register of Licensed Stablecoin Issuers instead. [S:28616d929735, Testing in the sandbox section, para 2]; [S:afb6cd0da6ff, paras 4-5]
Run the ML/TF risk assessment before launching any new product (for example, a VA, tokenisation or stablecoin service), new business practice or new technology. [S:7bfdad704174, paras 2.10-2.11]
Brief the board so it understands cryptoasset risks firm-wide and sets limits within risk appetite. [S:349a543ae2f0, para 4.2.8, pp.63-64]
Complete a comprehensive risk assessment before custody launch, under board oversight. [S:ce05e67bcdce, para 1]
Update technology-risk, continuity and outsourcing policies for DLT factors. [S:1884530ff235, Annex, item 1]
Apply the para 11 key controls to client VAs, including 98% cold storage. [S:ce05e67bcdce, para 11 and fn 8]
Monitor custody security 24/7, test system changes before deployment and monitor dependencies. [S:ce05e67bcdce, paras 23-25]
Keep documented classification evidence for each cryptoasset exposure. [S:b7d630146e6c, para 2.1.1]
Take the DLT considerations into account when preparing DLT-related submissions, as the HKMA encourages. [S:cd5d66ba08a2, p.2]

Obtain HKMA consent before appointing an HKMA-licensed stablecoin issuer to hold the stablecoins it issues; its keys must be kept in Hong Kong or a location the HKMA accepts. [S:ce05e67bcdce, para 11(b) and fn 7; para 14]
Document due diligence on custody delegates and HSM vendors, and review them regularly. [S:ce05e67bcdce, paras 11(a), 15]
Vet tokenisation platforms and staking providers before use and monitor them after. [S:b2719f3dcb37, Section A, p.3]; [S:4641e6c404d2, section C, p.3]
Consider whether DLT node operators are trustworthy, reliable and diverse. [S:1884530ff235, Annex, item 5]
Classify every VA-linked product and apply the PI-only, suitability and knowledge-test rules that follow from that classification [S:8a016a912528, paras 5–10].
Carry out extra due diligence on any VA fund that is not SFC-authorised, using Appendix 4 [S:8a016a912528, para 12.3].
Give VA risk disclosures and warning statements to clients other than institutional or qualified corporate PIs [S:8a016a912528, para 15].
Receive or withdraw client VAs only through segregated accounts at the partner platform or at an AI that meets HKMA custody standards [S:8a016a912528, para 20(b)].

For Relevant Stablecoins, disclose material information on the coin's stabilisation mechanism and redemption arrangements. Commission rebates or other benefits should not be the main basis for soliciting or recommending one [S:a0bd48559762, paras (5), (8), (10)].
Have adequate policies, procedures and controls, and train staff, for Relevant Stablecoin activities [S:a0bd48559762, Implementation, p.9].
Keep Relevant-Stablecoin-only clients to Relevant Stablecoins. Before dealing in any other VA for them, apply the full rules, including the knowledge test [S:a0bd48559762, fn 4].

Keep the listed records on client VAs, staking and VA financing for at least seven years. Records of orders and instructions on client VAs need be kept for at least two years [S:31b4f67e0233, paras 9.6–9.8].
Obtain an executed staking-risk acknowledgement from clients other than institutional or qualified corporate PIs before staking [S:31b4f67e0233, paras 8.7(b), 8.8].

When relying on VA collateral, monitor its volatility in real time. Treat loans secured only by VAs as clean loans, because the Banking (Capital) Rules do not recognise VA collateral [S:e64b7b0267b2, paras (5)(b), (9)].
Tell the SFC in advance, and the HKMA where applicable, about any new VA activity or change to one, including a change in the type of client served [S:8a016a912528, para 31].
Notify before the first client VA deposit or withdrawal, the first staking service, or the first VA-funded subscription or redemption [S:d5ebca32c92b, para 10].
A bank that is an AI but not an RI should follow the same standards and discuss any Relevant Stablecoin dealing, advice or portfolio management with the HKMA before starting [S:1babdb609fc8, pp.1–2].
Report any material breach of the terms, whether actual or suspected, to the SFC and the HKMA as soon as practicable [S:31b4f67e0233, para 12.1].

Confirm that the platform holds an actual SFC licence. Platforms that are only deemed licensed under AMLO Schedule 3G do not count (AMLO = Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Ordinance) [S:8a016a912528, para 17 and fn 20].
Use only an SFC-licensed platform or an AI as the staking service provider. Confirm it has SFC approval or has discussed the service with the HKMA [S:31b4f67e0233, paras 8.2–8.3].

For in-kind or VA-funded subscriptions, hold the VAs only at SFC-licensed platforms or AIs, and comply with the VA chapter (Chapter 12) of the SFC's anti-money-laundering (AML) guideline for those transfers [S:d5ebca32c92b, para 7(b)–(c)].

Apply the joint circular's selling rules when distributing any SFC-authorised VA fund, including the knowledge test for all clients except institutional and qualified corporate PIs [S:c79c4686c5e0, para 27; S:8a016a912528, paras 6.2, 9].

Offer VA-related products that are complex products, such as VA funds not authorised by the SFC, only to PIs. For non-authorised VA funds, first do the Appendix 4 due diligence on the fund, its manager and its trading and custody counterparties [S:8a016a912528, paras 5, 6.1, 12.3; S:100fb9e3e215, Appendix 4].
As a distributor of tokenised authorised products, be an LC or RI and apply the usual onboarding and suitability rules [S:58ea8520974d, para 18].

For tokenised products that fall outside the Securities and Futures Ordinance (SFO) regime, and for tokenised deposits placed by customers, the HKMA expects the selling rules for the underlying product to apply. It also expects AIs to understand and control the extra risks from tokenisation [S:b2719f3dcb37, pp.1–3 and fn 1]. RIs selling tokenised products other than tokenised securities should follow this HKMA guidance [S:d5ebca32c92b, fn 2].

As a Connecting Broker (an LC or RI routing clients' trades to a VATP), show the price-deviation alert, tell clients they can subscribe or redeem at NAV instead, and get their confirmation of the risks before onboarding [S:a64e364fd912, paras 13, 20(c) and fn 4].
Keep an online interface showing indicative NAV, usually refreshed at least every 15 seconds while trading is open, plus the last NAV [S:a64e364fd912, para 20(b)].
Where VA-related products are sold online, design the platform with access rights and controls that enforce selling restrictions [S:8a016a912528, para 11].
Give the SFC advance notice, and the HKMA too where relevant, before first letting clients subscribe or redeem with VAs, including in-kind flows [S:d5ebca32c92b, paras 7(a), 10(d)].
Before first engaging in secondary trading of tokenised products, notify the SFC. RIs are reminded to notify the HKMA too [S:a64e364fd912, para 27 and fn 13].
Before starting activities covered by the HKMA tokenised-products circular, discuss them with the HKMA [S:b2719f3dcb37, Implementation, p.6].

For in-kind flows, hold the VAs only in accounts with SFC-licensed platforms or AIs [S:d5ebca32c92b, para 7(b)]. The supplemental joint circular also points to Chapter 12 of the SFC's anti-money laundering (AML) guideline for LCs and SFC-licensed VA service providers when handling these VA transfers [S:d5ebca32c92b, para 7(c)].
Do product due diligence on each VA-related product: its risks and features, target investors and selling restrictions, and regulatory status [S:8a016a912528, para 12.3].

On tokenised products covered by the HKMA circular, do due diligence on the issuer and its technology vendors, including smart-contract audits, private key management and distributed ledger technology (DLT) contingency plans [S:b2719f3dcb37, Section A, pp.3–4].

Keep client assets and wallet addresses segregated from the bank's own. Do not lend, pledge or encumber client assets except for settlement or fees owed, with prior explicit written consent, or where the law requires it [S:ce05e67bcdce, paras 6–7 and fn 6].
Be liable for losses attributable to the bank, and hold adequate financial resources to cover them [S:ce05e67bcdce, para 11(n)].

Disclose the custody arrangements to clients fully and fairly. This covers rights on insolvency, segregation, insurance or compensation, commingling, and how forks and airdrops are handled [S:ce05e67bcdce, para 20].
Keep 98% of client VAs in cold storage, and keep seeds, keys and backups in Hong Kong [S:ce05e67bcdce, para 11(b), (l) and fn 8].
Train transaction signers in depth and run drills of the business continuity plan [S:ce05e67bcdce, paras 3, 5].
Reconcile each client's holdings regularly against both on-chain and off-chain records, and escalate discrepancies to senior management [S:ce05e67bcdce, para 21].
Monitor security 24/7, covering dependencies such as vendors, blockchain protocols, encryption algorithms and common libraries [S:ce05e67bcdce, paras 23–24].
Discuss plans with the HKMA before launching custody, and show that the bank meets the standards [S:ed61d7c335e7, Implementation, p.2].
Discuss staking plans with the HKMA before launch [S:4641e6c404d2, Implementation, p.3].
Provide custody records to the HKMA promptly when asked [S:ce05e67bcdce, para 22].

As a general principle, delegate VA custody only to another AI (or a local AI's subsidiary), to an SFC-licensed VATP, or, with HKMA consent, to a licensed stablecoin issuer for the coins it issues [S:ce05e67bcdce, para 14].

Before onboarding a custodian, include independent code reviews and understand how it develops and releases software. After onboarding, regularly evaluate its security controls, require timely incident reporting, and test its disaster recovery [S:ce05e67bcdce, para 15].

For a VATP counterparty, the SFC's own custody standards are in the VATP Guidelines, for example paras 10.6–10.8 (cold storage, whitelisted addresses, key management) and 10.22 (compensation arrangement), as elaborated in 25EC44 [S:f1bbafccd556, paras 10.6–10.8, 10.22; S:562c0f8addce, pp.1–2]. The HKMA annex cites the VATP Guidelines for reference on delegation [S:ce05e67bcdce, fn 10].
As an offeror, offer only licensed-issuer coins to retail; offer other specified stablecoins only to professional investors. [S:7b6c8dc63140, reply (1), para 1]; [S:0df2de5234dc, para 4]
For Relevant Stablecoin dealing, advice and portfolio management, follow the RI standards and the Appendix A1 and A2 terms; the HKMA expects this of all AIs. [S:1babdb609fc8, p.1]
Disclose material information on each Relevant Stablecoin's stabilisation and redemption arrangements when dealing or advising. [S:a0bd48559762, para (5), p.5 and para (10), p.7]

To use the Relevant-Stablecoin-only relief, clearly demarcate those client accounts and deal no other VAs for those clients; dealing other VAs for a client brings back the full VA requirements, including the knowledge assessment. [S:a0bd48559762, para (3)(a) and fn 4, p.4]
Keep advice grounded in the client's use case, not commission rebates. [S:a0bd48559762, para (8), p.6]

Classify stablecoin holdings under CRP-1 (Group 1b only if classification conditions 1-4 are met; full redeemability means redemption within five calendar days). [S:b7d630146e6c, paras 1.3.1-1.3.2, 2.3.2]

For liquidity (category 1 institutions), treat held stablecoins as non-HQLA (high-quality liquid assets) debt securities: generally a 0% inflow under the liquidity coverage ratio (LCR) and an 85% required stable funding factor under the net stable funding ratio (NSFR). An issuing bank must apply a 100% LCR outflow if the coin is redeemable within the LCR period, with lower rates possible where the backing assets are HQLA-eligible. [S:69600121310a, Annex 3, paras 6-7]
RIs: notify the HKMA and SFC before any Relevant Stablecoin activity or material change. [S:a0bd48559762, Implementation, p.9]
All AIs: discuss Relevant Stablecoin services with the HKMA first. [S:1babdb609fc8, Implementation, p.2]
Notify the HKMA on acquiring a new type of cryptoasset, and treat it as Group 2b until the HKMA agrees the classification. [S:b7d630146e6c, para 2.1.2]
Check a claimed issuer against the HKMA Register of licensees; the HKMA points the public to the Register to verify licensees. [S:270f1f7324ab, Register table]; [S:afb6cd0da6ff, paras 4-5]

An AI may delegate custody of stablecoins to a licensed issuer only for that issuer's own coins, and only if the issuer has the HKMA's consent to provide that custody. [S:ce05e67bcdce, para 14 and fn 7]
Apply existing product-selling rules to tokenised products, plus the tokenisation-specific expectations. [S:b2719f3dcb37, pp.2-3]
Apply the circular's standards when customers place tokenised deposits. [S:b2719f3dcb37, fn 1]
As a distributor of tokenised SFC-authorised products, the bank should be a regulated intermediary (e.g. an RI) and follow existing onboarding and suitability rules. [S:58ea8520974d, para 18]
Carry out due diligence before offering and at intervals after, on the product, its issuer and third-party vendors, including key management and audits. [S:b2719f3dcb37, Section A, pp.3-4]
Give customers plain-language tokenisation risk disclosures. [S:b2719f3dcb37, Section B, pp.4-5]
If providing custody of tokenised products, meet the HKMA's digital asset custody standards. [S:b2719f3dcb37, Section D, p.6]
Discuss tokenised-product plans with the HKMA in advance. [S:b2719f3dcb37, 'Implementation', p.6]
As an RI, notify the SFC and the HKMA before digital-securities activity. [S:a9aa06fbcc12, para 35 and fn 8]
As an RI in secondary trading of tokenised SFC-authorised products, also notify the HKMA. [S:a64e364fd912, para 27 and fn 13]
Optional: use the HKMA's Supervisory Incubator for DLT to reaffirm risk controls before a full launch. [S:1b1a0de5de5a, para 3]
Assess the issuer's and tokenisation platform's track record, key-management and ownership-record controls. [S:b2719f3dcb37, Section A, pp.3-4]

For tokenised bonds, consider the product's legal status and whether settlement is final. [S:b2719f3dcb37, Section A, p.4; Section B, p.5] For example, the HKMA states that CMU settlement of the Government digital green bonds has finality protected by statute. [S:4290ec1111e3, fn 2]
Offer VA financing only to securities margin financing clients, based on financial capability and posted collateral. [S:e64b7b0267b2, items (1)-(2), p.2]
Treat loans secured solely by VA as clean loans for capital. [S:e64b7b0267b2, item (9), p.5]
Do not repledge, reuse or encumber VA collateral except to enforce it on client default. [S:e64b7b0267b2, item (7)(c), p.5]
If relying on VA collateral, document VA risk-assessment methods in the margin lending policy, and monitor vulnerable VA exposures on an ongoing basis. [S:e64b7b0267b2, item (5)(a), p.4]
If relying on VA collateral, keep the ability to monitor its volatility in real time and act promptly. [S:e64b7b0267b2, item (5)(b), p.4]
Set prudent margin-call and stop-advance triggers, and act on them. [S:e64b7b0267b2, item (8), p.5]
For withdrawals: monitor continuously, with escalation and suspension also outside office hours. [S:e64b7b0267b2, p.6]; [S:73dac3a5a832, para 20(b)]

The HKMA circular sets no separate notification step. For new digital-asset activity, the HKMA's existing expectation is that banks discuss plans with it before launch. [S:3ec5b269b5dc, letter body para 5, p.2]
Contacts for queries are named in the circular, by topic. [S:e64b7b0267b2, p.6]

Before shared order book trading, assess the operators' conflicts of interest, the settlement mechanism, failure and default processes, reserve fund and insurance, and client recourse. [S:e64b7b0267b2, p.6]; [S:73dac3a5a832, para 16]
Work with the partner VATP as needed on withdrawal limits and blocking suspicious withdrawals. [S:e64b7b0267b2, p.6]; [S:73dac3a5a832, para 20(c)]
Keep an outage contingency plan for the VATP used to value collateral. [S:e64b7b0267b2, item (6), p.4]
If the bank offers VA dealing, partner only with SFC-licensed platforms, via an omnibus account or by introducing clients. [S:8a016a912528, para 17]
Offer VA dealing only to clients of the bank's Type 1 (dealing in securities) business. [S:8a016a912528, para 18]

As an RI, the HKMA expects you to follow the SFC's shared-order-book guidance for brokers when trading for clients on such a book or giving retail clients access. [S:e64b7b0267b2, 'Shared Order Book', p.6]
As an RI permitting client VA withdrawals, apply the SFC's withdrawal safeguards on top of HKMA e-banking and technology rules. [S:e64b7b0267b2, 'Client VA withdrawals', p.6]
Re-check a platform's status on the live SFC lists before onboarding and at review; the lists can lag between updates. [S:dddd919625e9, Note 1]; [S:b14be2203d39, applicant section Note 1]
Give the SFC, and the HKMA where relevant, advance notice before starting or changing VA activities. [S:8a016a912528, para 31]

When banking a VASP, run a risk-based anti-money laundering and counter-financing of terrorism (AML/CFT) assessment; depending on the relationship, the HKMA says extra correspondent-style checks may be needed, such as understanding its business, its licensing status and its AML/CFT controls. [S:642680fa4467, section (b) 'Banking relationships with VASPs', p.4]
For a VASP located outside Hong Kong, find out whether the account serves its own use or its clients; if clients, apply the correspondent-banking measures. [S:7bfdad704174, paras 11.23-11.24]
Benchmark a partner platform against the VATP Guidelines: token committee, retail index test, 98% cold storage, compensation cover. [S:f1bbafccd556, paras 7.1, 7.8, 10.6(c), 10.22]
Ask whether the platform has fixed the gaps in the SFC's inspection findings. [S:0c93d9a066e6, p.1 and Appendix 2]
Classify every cryptoasset exposure under BCR Part 12 and CRP-1, and keep assessing it on an ongoing basis. [S:b7d630146e6c, paras 1.1.4, 2.1.1]
Move an asset agreed as Group 1a, 1b or 2a to Group 2b at once if it stops meeting its conditions or criteria. [S:b7d630146e6c, para 2.1.3]
As an RI, treat loans secured only by VA collateral as clean loans for capital purposes. [S:e64b7b0267b2, para (9), p.5]
Keep policies, staff and IT able to assess cryptoasset risk, and document the evidence for each classification. [S:b7d630146e6c, para 2.1.1]
For stablecoins, keep a monitoring framework that checks the stabilisation mechanism works as intended. [S:b7d630146e6c, para 2.2.4]
If the bank is a G-SIB or D-SIB, track the Group 2 exposure ratio against the 1% and 2% thresholds used in disclosure. [S:9e8d84c87168, Part XII CAE1 explanatory note, rows 8-10, p.215]
Notify the HKMA before acquiring any new type of cryptoasset. [S:b7d630146e6c, para 2.1.2]
Give the HKMA classification evidence on request. [S:b7d630146e6c, para 2.1.1]

For Group 1 assets, check that every entity redeeming, transferring, storing or settling the asset (or managing its reserves) is regulated and supervised or meets suitable risk standards, and discloses a governance framework. [S:b7d630146e6c, para 2.5.1]
File the revised crypto items in MA(BS)1E, 3, 3A, 26, 27 and 28 on the stated schedules. [S:30b686db29f9, p.3]; [S:f4e64fda4011, para 5]; [S:767a346fbcaa, para 4]; [S:527c897d3eed, para 4]
If Hong Kong-incorporated, complete MA(BS)3 Part IIIf, including the Group 2 exposure ratio. [S:d1fbf6c0736a, paras 1, 11]
Publish Table CAEA and Templates CAE1-CAE3 as they apply to the bank. [S:e10295e5fe20, Annex A, pp.61-62]; [S:9e8d84c87168, Part XII, pp.210-218]
In CAE1, use daily mean values over the period for the specified Group 2a columns (long, short) and Group 2b columns (total, long, short). [S:9e8d84c87168, CAE1 points to note (i), p.213]
Run the 0.3% / 5% materiality test at each period end to decide which Group 2 assets need their own CAE1 row. [S:9e8d84c87168, CAE1 points to note (iii), p.214]
Refer to the HKMA's explanatory notes, alongside the BDR, when filling in each standard template and table. [S:e10295e5fe20, para 2.1]
If systems are not ready for the revised returns, agree a temporary arrangement with the HKMA. [S:30b686db29f9, p.4]

For each Group 1 asset, be ready to describe how the bank assessed the four classification conditions, including the public information used, as CAEA asks for this. [S:9e8d84c87168, Table CAEA point (f), p.211]
Complete CDD before any occasional VA transfer of HK$8,000 or more, and watch for linked transfers. [S:7bfdad704174, paras 4.2.1(b)(iii), 4.2.4–4.2.5]
Meet AMLO Schedule 2, section 13A for VA transfers the bank carries out. [S:7bfdad704174, fn 15; S:16fd7cfab136, Part II para 4.3]
Run an ML/TF risk assessment and put mitigants in place before launching any VA-related product, service or new technology. [S:7bfdad704174, paras 2.10–2.11; S:642680fa4467, pp.2–3]
Keep VA transfer and relationship records for the periods in para 8.4. [S:7bfdad704174, para 8.4]
Monitor customers' VA-platform flows and look into their nature. [S:642680fa4467, AML/CFT section (a), pp.3–4]
Keep transaction-monitoring parameters and thresholds documented, regularly reviewed and independently validated. [S:7bfdad704174, para 5.8]
In the RI business, apply SFC Chapter 12 when handling client VA deposits and withdrawals. [S:8a016a912528, para 20(b)]
Discuss any planned VA activity with the HKMA before launch. [S:642680fa4467, 'AIs' VA-related proposals', p.5]

For the RI: notify the SFC and HKMA when it intends to engage in VA activities (dealing, advisory, asset management) or to change them, including the type of clients served. [S:8934af8cc884, para 5.6]
File STRs with the Joint Financial Intelligence Unit (JFIU) where suspicion is identified. [S:7bfdad704174, paras 5.10–5.12]

For overseas VASPs receiving correspondent-like services: understand the business, check reputation and supervision, assess AML controls, get senior management approval. [S:7bfdad704174, paras 11.6, 11.23–11.24]
Confirm with a VASP customer that its operations do not breach applicable laws in Hong Kong or elsewhere. [S:642680fa4467, AML/CFT section (b), p.4]
Know that the SFC expects licensed firms to register client bank accounts used for deposits and withdrawals, and to whitelist client wallet addresses. [S:be46918f8aa2, para 20]
Keep board and senior management ownership of DLT risk and update technology-risk, continuity and outsourcing policies. [S:1884530ff235, Annex item 1]
For custody: run a comprehensive risk assessment before launch, with board and senior management oversight before and during the activity. [S:ce05e67bcdce, para 1]

For client VAs, meet the key-management controls in para 11 (HSMs, keys in Hong Kong, no smart contracts in cold wallets on public blockchains, anti-blind-signing, 98% cold storage). [S:ce05e67bcdce, para 11, fn 8]
Use system controls and whitelists to stop unauthorised cold-wallet transfers, and verify each transaction systematically. [S:ce05e67bcdce, para 10]
Run 24/7 security monitoring, and test system changes thoroughly before deployment. [S:ce05e67bcdce, para 23]
Build DLT-specific scenarios (cyberattacks, key loss or theft, forks) into continuity plans for critical functions. [S:1884530ff235, Annex item 10]

An HKMA speech says banks should secure their own and critical service providers' cyber fundamentals, and that frontier artificial intelligence risks should not be underestimated. [S:a50e9dc16dc7, slide 10]
Discuss VA activity with the HKMA, and get its feedback on risk controls, before launch. [S:642680fa4467, p.5]

SFC-licensed firms in the bank's group should promptly report material cyber incidents to the SFC, and internet brokers or VASPs should notify their case officer at once if they expect difficulty meeting the July 2027 authentication deadline. [S:a4929c8f9f3e, para 18; S:724f4d9f786e, para 23]
Assess whether node operators are trustworthy, reliable and diverse before relying on a DLT network. [S:1884530ff235, Annex item 5]
For custody delegates: independent code reviews, understanding of release processes, and regular evaluation of security controls and disaster-recovery testing. [S:ce05e67bcdce, para 15]

A bank may delegate VA custody to an SFC-licensed VATP after due diligence; the SFC's own VATP custody standards (HSMs, air-gapped signing devices, a security operations centre, 24/7 monitoring) show what such a platform is expected to have. [S:ce05e67bcdce, paras 14–15; S:562c0f8addce, paras 2, 7, 10, 18, 24]
Map whether any group entity, as a business, carries out crypto exchange transactions for customers, including as intermediary. [S:e8c0a71f0cc5, s.50M]
Test each such entity against the Hong Kong nexus rules, including branches. [S:e8c0a71f0cc5, s.50N(1)-(2)]
Plan registration by 31 January of the year after nexus is first met. [S:e8c0a71f0cc5, s.50O(2)]
Plan for due diligence from 1 January 2027, including self-certifications for existing users within 12 months. [S:e8c0a71f0cc5, Clause 1(3)]; [S:d70ae2cbc9d1, 'Due diligence requirements']
Prepare CRS systems for amended CRS due diligence from 1 January 2028. [S:e8c0a71f0cc5, Clause 1(4)]; [S:275d5cc93a88, para 4.18]
Keep CARF due-diligence evidence and reporting records for six years after each return's due date. [S:d70ae2cbc9d1, 'Record keeping requirements']
If CARF work is outsourced, keep oversight; under the bill, using a service provider would not in itself be a reasonable excuse. [S:e8c0a71f0cc5, s.80R(2)]
If using self-developed software, plan to submit test data files to the IRD for validation; the consultation's plan set the fourth quarter of 2027 for this. [S:275d5cc93a88, Chapter 6 item (1)(c)]

CARF registration and returns would go to the IRD through its planned CARF Portal, not to the HKMA or SFC; watch for the portal and data schema. [S:d70ae2cbc9d1, 'Reporting portal and mandatory registration requirement']

Where the bank partners with a crypto trading platform or broker, note that the counterparty may itself be an RCASP with its own reporting. [S:d70ae2cbc9d1, 'Individuals and entities subject to due diligence and reporting requirements']

Inventory current and planned VA dealing, custody, advisory and management activity. Intermediaries now doing VA activities under SFC licensing or registration conditions will need a licence or registration under the new regimes. [S:01c5c5c4045f, para 62]

Plan for a fixed start date with no transition: no deeming arrangement is planned, and dealers that have not contacted the SFC or HKMA may have to stop operations on that date. [S:6186c01c6649, paras 31-32, 34]
Note that, once in force, the regimes will prohibit actively marketing VA advisory or management services to the Hong Kong public without a licence or registration. [S:01c5c5c4045f, para 70]
Note the SFC's stated plan to start running its digital-asset custody surveillance system starting in the second half of 2026. [S:ef3648ff1610, para 51(iii)]
Track the CARF start date (1 January 2027 in the bill) for any group entity that may be an RCASP. [S:e8c0a71f0cc5, Clause 1(3)]
The regulators encourage firms interested in VA dealing to approach the SFC (or the HKMA, where relevant) early to begin pre-application. [S:6186c01c6649, para 33]
Existing and would-be VA advisers and managers are strongly encouraged to start pre-application talks with the SFC early. [S:4a0342268bf2, para 7]
Under the dealing regime, check that VA custodians used for client assets are SFC-regulated. [S:6186c01c6649, para 26]

The SFC's 27 May 2026 circular covers only Relevant Stablecoins: specified stablecoins issued by an HKMA-licensed issuer and authorised under its licence. It does not cover other stablecoins. [S:19d52ade6849, preamble, para 2]

On mBridge, run AML, counter-terrorist financing (CTF) and sanctions checks off the platform before sending a payment; the receiving bank runs its own check before confirming. [S:947fa49606ab, s.6.5.2, p.30]
On mBridge, meet each jurisdiction's AML/CTF/sanctions laws; the platform attaches a pass or fail certificate from the bank's off-platform check to each transaction. [S:947fa49606ab, s.7.2(d), p.35]
Keep KYC, AML and CTF compliance off-bridge in the bank's own systems. [S:89b8fcadfaa8, p.3]

For any e-HKD distribution role, note that the 2022 policy paper said a two-tier design could task customer-facing institutions with customer due diligence and record-keeping. [S:3b42966a786e, Section 5.4, p.35]

Banks may use the HKMA Supervisory Incubator for distributed ledger technology (DLT) to reaffirm their risk controls before a full DLT launch; tokenised deposits are a core focus. [S:1b1a0de5de5a, paras 2-3]
On mBridge, foreign banks can hold and use a CBDC, but only domestic banks can have it issued or redeemed against reserves. Check which role each counterparty has. [S:947fa49606ab, s.7.1.1, pp.31-32]

talking.md: The bank's VA conduct duties reach it as an RI supervised day to day by the HKMA, not through direct SFC supervision. [S:8934af8cc884, para 2.1.3]

The bank must comply with the HKMA's anti-money laundering and counter-financing of terrorism (AML/CFT) Guideline; as an RI it must also have regard to the SFC's AML/CFT Guideline, including its Chapter 12 on VAs. [S:7bfdad704174, Ch.1 fn 1]
Any new VA product needs an HKMA discussion before launch, and RIs must pre-notify the SFC and HKMA. [S:642680fa4467, p.5]; [S:8934af8cc884, para 5.6]
Only two stablecoin issuers are licensed; the Government says any further licences would keep the total very limited. [S:270f1f7324ab, Register table]; [S:3f0fcc104e61, Reply (2)]
The Government proposed an SFC-led licensing model for VA dealing and custody, with the HKMA as the banks' frontline regulator. [S:a29b51bffc6b, paras 5-6]
No deeming (grandfathering) arrangement is planned when these regimes start. [S:6186c01c6649, para 31]

The Basel cryptoasset standard applies from 1 January 2026; exposures held before that date, and any new type of cryptoasset, stay in Group 2b until the HKMA agrees the bank's classification. [S:b7d630146e6c, paras 1.4.1-1.4.2, 2.1.2]
The HKMA's custody annex expects AIs to keep 98% of client VAs in cold storage. [S:ce05e67bcdce, para 11(l) and fn 8]
Our AML Guideline says *should* marks a mandatory requirement, the same as *must*. [S:7bfdad704174, para 1.6]
Check each SPM module's classification: SB-1 is statutory; CRP-1 is a guidance note that yields to the BCR. [S:8934af8cc884, cover, Classification]; [S:b7d630146e6c, para 1.1.4]

Conclusions papers are not law; the FSTB and SFC aim to put a bill for the dealing regime into LegCo in 2026, and the Budget said the same for dealing and custodian regimes. [S:6186c01c6649, p.4, Next step]; [S:654fa5eba8cf, para 104]
The conclusions state no plan for a deeming arrangement and encourage early SFC/HKMA engagement. [S:6186c01c6649, paras 31, 33-34]

Hong Kong's path runs from consultation to conclusions, bill, commencement and transition; for stablecoins, consultation began on 27 December 2023 and the Ordinance commenced on 1 August 2025, about 19 months later. [S:54aa01e7396e, Introduction, para 1]; [S:0df2de5234dc, para 1]
Budget items such as planned bills are stated intentions, not obligations. [S:654fa5eba8cf, paras 104, 108]
The negative-vetting period for the cryptoasset capital rules expired without extension, and the rules apply from 1 January 2026. [S:974899bbef4d, letter, paras 1-2]
HKMA letters can change how capital guidance applies with immediate effect, as in June 2026. [S:dca53ff0a62c, p.1, paras 3-4]

The 2026 licensing regime is still a target: the bill has to be introduced into LegCo. The business-model circular, by contrast, already sets a board expectation for every AI. [S:cc2fa9fc0772, Annex, New Indicators, item 22]; [S:3ec5b269b5dc, letter body, p.2]
Government now says *digital assets*, but AMLO still uses *virtual asset*. [S:a29b51bffc6b, footnote 1]; [S:f1bbafccd556, para 1.1]
The SFC will promote trading of regulated stablecoins on licensed platforms and their use to settle tokenised money market funds. [S:ef3648ff1610, para 49(iii)]
EnsembleTX is to add CBDC settlement and 24/7 operation by around end-2026. [S:ef3648ff1610, para 50]
The HKMA says banks have an opportunity to act as a key intermediary between traditional finance and digital assets, and expects a board-endorsed plan. [S:3ec5b269b5dc, letter body, pp.1-2]
The government's stated 2026 target is a bill for digital-asset dealing and custody licensing. [S:cc2fa9fc0772, Annex, New Indicators, item 22]
The Blueprint's Quantum Preparedness Index assesses banks' readiness for post-quantum cryptography; the first index reading was 2.3 out of 10. [S:b0607b779270, para 4]; [S:a50e9dc16dc7, slide 11]
ASPIRe may shift custody rules toward outcome-based standards, but that is still exploratory. [S:d461c2db6af2, Pillar S, Initiative 3]
Our VA conduct rules reach us as an RI; the HKMA supervises, the SFC keeps ultimate responsibility. [S:8934af8cc884, para 2.1.3]

Scope matters: the May 2026 Relevant Stablecoin circular is addressed to RIs, while the separate stablecoin-activity letter covers all AIs. [S:a0bd48559762, p.1; footnote 3, p.2]; [S:1babdb609fc8, p.1]
As an RI, we should notify the SFC and HKMA when we intend to start or change VA services. [S:8934af8cc884, para 5.6]
Under the proposed custodian regime, a custody subsidiary would be regulated by the SFC, while the HKMA would be frontline regulator for the bank itself. [S:30b60438f017, para 2.12(a)]
Under the proposed dealing and custody regimes, the SFC would license and register providers, while the HKMA would be frontline regulator for banks. [S:a29b51bffc6b, paras 5-6]
The MA can withdraw or suspend an executive officer's consent for misconduct, and each regulated activity must always have at least one executive officer on hand. [S:8934af8cc884, paras 2.2.4, 6.3]
A bank VA custodian would use existing HKMA capital rules, not the custodian capital baseline. [S:f41a543388bc, para 41]
The RI financing circular requires loans secured solely by VAs to be handled as clean loans for capital purposes. [S:e64b7b0267b2, para (9), p.5]

Every VA, tokenisation, custody, staking or stablecoin launch starts with an HKMA discussion; for RI activities the SFC and HKMA also expect advance notice. [S:642680fa4467, p.5]; [S:8934af8cc884, para 5.6]
The 2026 custody letter dropped the six-month confirmation; existing custodians should review and revise their controls instead. [S:ed61d7c335e7, Implementation, p.2]
The HKMA discussion comes before go-live for any new digital-asset activity, as the March 2026 circular restates. [S:3ec5b269b5dc, letter body, para 5]
Changing client type, or first allowing VA deposits, staking or VA-funded subscriptions, should be flagged in advance to the SFC and, where relevant, the HKMA. [S:b79266f3da51, para 10]
The HKMA asked each board to endorse a digital-transformation business plan within six months of 9 March 2026. [S:3ec5b269b5dc, letter body, para 4]
The Supervisory Incubator gives banks a dedicated HKMA team for supervisory feedback, and optional live trials, before a full DLT launch. [S:1b1a0de5de5a, para 3]
A new cryptoasset type must be notified to the HKMA on acquisition and sits in Group 2b until the HKMA agrees to the bank's classification. [S:b7d630146e6c, para 2.1.2]
Equity-like tokens count as shares for the 5%-of-Tier-1 consent test. [S:13365a31e794, fn 1]
The HKMA AML/CFT Guideline requires an ML/TF risk assessment before any new product, practice or technology launch; should there is mandatory. [S:7bfdad704174, paras 1.6, 2.10-2.11]
The DLT considerations are non-binding, but the HKMA encourages banks to take them into account in DLT-related submissions. [S:cd5d66ba08a2, p.2]
As a general principle, VA custody can only be outsourced to another AI, an SFC-licensed platform, or a licensed stablecoin issuer (its own coins, with HKMA consent). [S:ce05e67bcdce, para 14]
Tokenised-product sales need issuer and technology-vendor due diligence before offering to customers. [S:b2719f3dcb37, Section A, p.3]

The HKMA expects the board to understand cryptoasset risks and to endorse a digital-transformation business plan within six months of 9 March 2026. [S:349a543ae2f0, para 4.2.8]; [S:3ec5b269b5dc, p.2, para 4]
Crypto-related gaps in capital or risk management may lead the HKMA to consider capital add-ons, provisioning or limits. [S:349a543ae2f0, para 3.6.6]
Custody keys: HSMs, Hong Kong location, sharding, anti-blind-signing, 98% cold storage for client VAs. [S:ce05e67bcdce, para 11 and fn 8]
DLT continuity plans should test key loss, cyberattacks and forks. [S:1884530ff235, Annex, item 10]

The regime reaches us as an RI through registration conditions that the SFC imposes, consulting the HKMA where applicable. The HKMA is our frontline, day-to-day supervisor [S:8a016a912528, para 19; S:8934af8cc884, para 2.1.3].
Our AML baseline is the HKMA AML Guideline. As an RI we are also required to have regard to the SFC guideline's VA chapter (Chapter 12) [S:7bfdad704174, para 1.3 fn 1].

SFC-authorised VA funds are not PI-only, and retail can buy listed ones on SEHK. We should still assess VA knowledge first. Overseas non-derivative VA exchange-traded products remain PI-only [S:8a016a912528, paras 6.1, 6.2, 9, 9.1].
Since May 2026, clearly ring-fenced Relevant-Stablecoin-only accounts need no knowledge test and no exposure limit. The coin must come from an HKMA-licensed issuer [S:a0bd48559762, p.1 and para (3)].

Parts of the regime were relaxed in December 2023, September 2025 and May 2026 [S:8a016a912528, para 9; S:d5ebca32c92b, para 2; S:a0bd48559762, Background]. Complex-product rules, knowledge tests and licensed venues remain [S:8a016a912528, paras 5, 6.2, 17].
In January 2026 the SFC fined a broker HK$4 million for VA distribution failures that ran from 2018 to 2022 [S:415e4629a80f, paras 1–2].

Margin clients can get VA financing. Eligible VA collateral is limited to bitcoin, ether and Relevant Stablecoins, with at least a 60% haircut on bitcoin and ether. VA collateral gets no capital recognition [S:e64b7b0267b2, paras (4), (9) and fn 5].
Discretionary VA exposure under Type 1 should stay below 10% of the client account's GAV [S:31b4f67e0233, para 4.7].
The VA fund circular is written for product providers. The bank's own duties as distributor or PD come from the joint circular and any extra SFC terms for PDs [S:c79c4686c5e0, paras 8, 19, 27].
For tokenised secondary trading, intermediaries notify the SFC first, and RIs are reminded to notify the HKMA as well [S:a64e364fd912, para 27 and fn 13].

SEHK-listed VA ETFs can be traded on exchange for retail clients without solicitation, with a knowledge test. Unlisted classes of the same ETF need full suitability [S:8a016a912528, paras 9.1–9.2, fn 14].
In-kind creation is allowed, and the VAs may come from overseas holdings. PDs are expected to move them into custody at a VATP or AI [S:c79c4686c5e0, paras 17(b), 18].

Hong Kong has moved from futures-only VA ETFs (2022) to spot VA funds (2023), fund staking (2025) and a pilot of 24/7 secondary trading of tokenised funds (2026) [S:51dac2cabe78, para 12; S:5b6530666cc2, para 5; S:353535602a83, para 27; S:bbd10edd41cf, para 4].
Tokenised-class assets were about $10.7 billion across 13 products as of March 2026 [S:bbd10edd41cf, para 3].
VA funds should not have leveraged VA exposure at fund level, and custody delegates are limited to VATPs, qualifying AIs, or entities the SFC accepts [S:c79c4686c5e0, paras 15, 20].
Staking by funds needs prior SFC consultation and approval. Interim and annual reports should show staked holdings as a share of NAV, along with revenue and costs [S:c79c4686c5e0, paras 28(f), 31].

The 2026 annex replaced the 2024 one. An existing service should review and revise its systems and controls to meet the latest standards; the letter sets no transition period [S:ed61d7c335e7, Implementation, p.2].

The custody annex no longer has an AML/CFT section, but the cover letter reminds AIs to comply with all applicable requirements, and the HKMA's AML/CFT Guideline sets the standards AIs should meet [S:ed61d7c335e7, p.2; S:7bfdad704174, para 1.3].
With HKMA consent, a bank may now delegate custody of a licensed stablecoin to its issuer [S:ce05e67bcdce, para 14(iii)].
Transfers to third parties for payments and settlement are now allowed if effective controls are in place [S:ce05e67bcdce, para 11(m)].
The fixed insurance percentages have been replaced by bank liability plus adequate financial resources; the annex sets no fixed percentage [S:ce05e67bcdce, para 11(n); S:86e064b2a8d0, fn 8].
The FSTB and SFC conclusions propose a statutory custodian licence with no deeming arrangement. Banks already assessed by the HKMA get an expedited process [S:f41a543388bc, paras 48, 51].
The SFC says the weaknesses shown by overseas incidents can arise whichever custody solution is used, whether HSM, MPC or multi-signature [S:562c0f8addce, p.1].
The HKMA lists slashing, lock-up and validator inactivity among staking risks to disclose. The bank should keep control of the means to unstake [S:4641e6c404d2, sections A–B].
Banks are permitted offerors; only licensed-issuer coins may be offered to retail investors. [S:fe4baea8dd7d, para 2.10.1]; [S:7b6c8dc63140, reply (1), para 1]
RIs notify the HKMA and SFC before Relevant Stablecoin activity; other AIs discuss with the HKMA first. [S:a0bd48559762, p.9]; [S:1babdb609fc8, p.2]

Two issuers are licensed (effective 10 April 2026); the HKMA says any further licences would keep the overall number very limited. [S:270f1f7324ab, Register table]; [S:193316443831, Follow-up work section, para 3]

Relevant-Stablecoin-only dealing is not limited to RIs registered for Type 1, and needs no VA knowledge assessment for clearly demarcated Relevant-Stablecoin-only accounts; Appendix A1 conditions still apply. [S:a0bd48559762, paras (2), (3)(a)]
An AI can apply to issue, and the financial-resources and business-activities minimum criteria do not apply to an AI applicant. [S:fe4baea8dd7d, para 3.2.1; fns 1, 8]
In June 2026 the Government expected the first regulated stablecoin launch as early as mid-2026. [S:3f0fcc104e61, Reply (1)]

A held stablecoin is treated as a non-HQLA debt security for liquidity; an issuing bank must apply a 100% LCR outflow if the coin is redeemable within the LCR period (lower rates possible with HQLA-eligible backing). [S:69600121310a, Annex 3, para 7]
HKMA-licensed coins can be deemed to meet CRP-1's extra permissionless-chain measures, but Group 1 still needs conditions 1-4. [S:b7d630146e6c, paras 1.3.1, 2.6.3]
Existing product rules apply to tokenised products, plus HKMA expectations on due diligence and disclosure, and advance discussion with the HKMA. [S:b2719f3dcb37, pp.2-6]

As an RI, the bank should tell both the SFC and the HKMA before digital-securities work, and notify the HKMA too before secondary trading of tokenised SFC-authorised products. [S:a9aa06fbcc12, fn 8]; [S:a64e364fd912, fn 13]

EnsembleTX is to operate throughout 2026 with real-value tokenised-deposit settlement. The HKMA invites stakeholders with real-value tokenised-deposit use cases to take part. [S:8b67e8dc510f, para 3 and CE remarks]
The DBGS Full Grant (up to HK$2.5m per issue) is not available if the DLT platform provider is an associate of the issuer. A Half Grant of up to HK$1.25m may still apply. [S:5a0563de8142, ss.1, 3]

The Government has made three tokenised bond issues; the latest raised about HK$10bn. The HKMC priced about HK$12bn in June 2026. [S:fc3eb72031c6, para 5]; [S:ac6cd085a325, para 1]; [S:6aa27ee8b400, para 1]
The Policy Address targets CBDC settlement and 24/7 operation for EnsembleTX around end-2026, and a CMU OmniClear digital asset platform this year. [S:ef3648ff1610, paras 35(iv), 50]

Tokenised deposits the bank issues cannot get stable-deposit treatment in the LCR. If the bank cannot always identify holders, it must treat them as other unsecured wholesale funding. [S:69600121310a, Annex 3 para 4]

The HKMA's non-binding DLT risk considerations (April 2024) cover network choice, smart contracts, legal risks such as settlement finality, third parties, interoperability, cybersecurity and private-key security. [S:1884530ff235, Introduction and items 2-8]

The HKMA's 27 May 2026 circular lets our RI offer VA margin financing if we observe standards similar to the SFC's. If we rely on VA collateral, it should be limited to bitcoin, ether and stablecoins from HKMA-licensed issuers. [S:e64b7b0267b2, items (1)-(4), pp.2-4]
Withdrawal and shared-order-book standards come from SFC 26EC5 paras 15-20, applied to RIs by the HKMA. [S:e64b7b0267b2, p.6]
Only securities margin financing clients qualify, and limits are not expected to rise just because VA financing exists. [S:e64b7b0267b2, items (2)-(3), p.2]
Retail clients can use a shared order book only after a prominent explanation of the overseas risks and an express election. [S:e64b7b0267b2, p.6]; [S:73dac3a5a832, para 17]
The SFC calls this a first step to bring margin trading into VA, aimed at liquidity in a risk-controlled setting. [S:73dac3a5a832, para 3]
The Banking (Capital) Rules give VA collateral no recognition, so loans secured solely by VA are treated as clean loans. [S:e64b7b0267b2, item (9), p.5]
Bitcoin and ether collateral should get a haircut of 60% or more. For stablecoins the HKMA asks only for a prudent haircut. [S:e64b7b0267b2, item (4), footnote 5, pp.3-4]

The HKMA notes that VAs have a limited track record in major systemic shocks, and even the most traded VA has seen large falls within a day and over several days. [S:e64b7b0267b2, item (3), closing paragraph, p.3]

The VATP Guidelines bind platforms, not the bank. For us they are a due-diligence yardstick, because our VA dealing must run through SFC-licensed platforms. [S:f1bbafccd556, para 1.2]; [S:8a016a912528, para 17]
On our own AML duties for VASP customers, we follow the HKMA AML/CFT Guideline, including correspondent-style checks on overseas VASPs. [S:7bfdad704174, paras 11.23-11.24]

Shared order books and affiliated market makers are now allowed for platforms, with SFC approval or notice; the SFC's perpetuals framework says those should go to professional investors only. [S:f009f1a6d615, para 26]; [S:84b3c1a0cee1, para 9]; [S:49f642bdee28, 'Eligible investors and reference assets']
If we give clients access to a platform's shared order book, the HKMA expects us to follow the SFC's broker guidance. [S:e64b7b0267b2, 'Shared Order Book', p.6]

Hong Kong moved from an opt-in, professional-only model (2019-2020) to mandatory licensing for all platforms from June 2023. [S:024089b01825, para 32]; [S:60682e9fd7fa, Note 1]; [S:2e5c35b38cc3, para 1]
The SFC’s licensed list showed 13 platforms at 29 May 2026. [S:b14be2203d39, Licensed platforms table]
The Guidelines say licensed platforms should hold 98% of client VAs cold and carry compensation cover of 50% of cold-stored and 100% of hot-stored client VAs. [S:f1bbafccd556, paras 10.6(c), 10.22]
The SFC's inspections of deemed applicants covered cybersecurity, client assets and KYC; it said platforms should act at once to fix gaps. [S:0c93d9a066e6, p.1]
The capital rules are law from 1 January 2026; CRP-1 is guidance, and the BCR wins if they differ. [S:b7d630146e6c, paras 1.1.4, 1.4.1]
New cryptoasset types need HKMA notification before purchase. [S:b7d630146e6c, para 2.1.2]
Until the HKMA agrees a classification, a new cryptoasset sits in Group 2b at a 1,250% risk weight. [S:b7d630146e6c, para 2.1.2]; [S:5d845665ba83, para 4.3.2]
Stablecoins under the HKMA licensing regime can be deemed to meet the permissionless-chain measures, but the four classification conditions still apply. [S:b7d630146e6c, paras 1.3.1, 2.6.3]
Hong Kong's rules started on 1 January 2026, matching the Basel timeline. [S:277820235891, closing para]
The HKMA can override our classifications and add capital or limits if it sees weaknesses. [S:b7d630146e6c, para 2.1.6]; [S:349a543ae2f0, para 3.6.6]
Any crypto exposure ends our market-risk de-minimis exemption. [S:b8d2d2a0f9c8, footnote 80]

For a category 1 institution, a stablecoin it holds is generally treated as non-HQLA, with a 0% LCR inflow and an 85% required stable funding factor under the net stable funding ratio (NSFR). [S:69600121310a, Annex 3 para 7]
Crypto reporting started on 1 January 2026; the no-exposure transition window ended on 30 June 2026. [S:30b686db29f9, p.3]
CA-D-1 is general guidance on the HKMA's approach; if it conflicts with the BDR, the BDR prevail. [S:e10295e5fe20, para 2.1]

A Transition AI that acquired crypto exposure after 1 January 2026 was grouped with exposed banks: if its systems were not ready, it could agree a temporary arrangement with the HKMA. [S:30b686db29f9, p.3-4]
The aggregate market value of cryptoassets held in custody for clients, split by type, goes into the public CAE1 narrative. [S:9e8d84c87168, CAE1 accompanying narrative, p.212]
If we have cryptoasset exposures, our public Pillar 3 report has a crypto section: an annual narrative plus semi-annual numbers. [S:e10295e5fe20, Annex A, pp.61-62]
Seven HKMA returns changed at once for the cryptoasset standard. [S:30b686db29f9, p.3]
Every Hong Kong-incorporated AI reports its Group 2 exposure ratio in Part IIIf; only G-SIBs and D-SIBs report the add-on. [S:d1fbf6c0736a, paras 11-12]
Tokenised deposits do not qualify for stable-deposit outflow rates in the liquidity return. [S:f4e64fda4011, para 31]

Our governing AML text for VAs is the HKMA AI Guideline; our RI business must have regard to SFC Chapter 12, and comply with it when handling client VA deposits or withdrawals. [S:7bfdad704174, para 1.3, fn 1; S:8a016a912528, para 20(b)]
For our own VA transfers the Guideline points to AMLO Schedule 2 s.13A, not the wire-transfer chapter. [S:7bfdad704174, fn 15]
Any VA product needs a documented ML/TF risk assessment and an HKMA conversation before launch. [S:7bfdad704174, para 2.11; S:642680fa4467, p.5]
Giving correspondent-like services to an overseas VASP means correspondent-style due diligence and senior management approval. [S:7bfdad704174, paras 11.6, 11.23–11.24]
The HKMA has said the AMLO does not prohibit AIs from VA transfers for customers if section 13A requirements are met. [S:16fd7cfab136, Part II para 4.3]
A Government reply to LegCo put sums involved in VA-related crime at HK$4,398m in 2023, up from HK$824m in 2021. [S:4bd22ccf481d, reply (1)–(2)]

SFC red flags for licensed firms include deposits and withdrawals with little or no trading, and a new eDDA setup followed by whitelisting a new wallet address. [S:be46918f8aa2, para 7; S:cfc4a0d9f1be, para 11]
An SFC circular notes FATF published a focused report on stablecoin and unhosted-wallet risks on 3 March 2026. [S:00c9fbd119bf, p.3 item (3)(c)]
The SFC OTP circular is addressed to internet brokers and VASPs, not the bank; our own custody baseline is the HKMA custody annex. [S:724f4d9f786e, para 1; S:ce05e67bcdce, para 11]
Several wallet controls in the HKMA 2026 custody annex use the same wording as the SFC's 2025 custody circular. [S:ce05e67bcdce, paras 10–11; S:562c0f8addce, Sections II–III]
Custody keys are to be kept in Hong Kong in tamper-resistant devices such as HSMs; smart contracts are out for cold wallets on public blockchains. [S:ce05e67bcdce, para 11(a)–(c)]
Counterparty platforms and internet brokers are expected to move client login and device binding off OTPs by 8 July 2027. [S:724f4d9f786e, paras 7, 21(c)]
The HKMA places responsibility for DLT adoption and its risks with the board and senior management. [S:1884530ff235, Annex item 1]
Phishing made up 57% of security incidents reported to HKCERT in 2025, as cited by the SFC. [S:724f4d9f786e, fn 5]
The HKMA's first quantum readiness score for the sector is 2.3 of 10, with 2030 as the objective for full readiness. [S:a50e9dc16dc7, slide 11]
The HKMA has warned about crypto firms presenting themselves as 'banks' and about tokens falsely linked to licensed stablecoin issuers. [S:19c8611c621a, para 2; S:275e7319a841, para 2]
The CARF bill had its First Reading on 3 June 2026. If passed, CARF duties would start on 1 January 2027 and amended CRS on 1 January 2028. [S:d70ae2cbc9d1, Overview]
Outsourcing CARF work to a vendor is not, in itself, a reasonable excuse for failing to register, do due diligence or report. [S:e8c0a71f0cc5, s.80R(2)]
Providing crypto exchange services for customers as a business, even as intermediary, could make the entity an RCASP. [S:e8c0a71f0cc5, s.50M]
New crypto customers will need a tax-residence self-certification; existing ones within 12 months of start. [S:d70ae2cbc9d1, 'Due diligence requirements']
Hong Kong committed to CARF in December 2024, with first data exchanges targeted from 2028. [S:ea81f92ea327, para 4]
The government linked CARF to Hong Kong's reputation as a financial centre. [S:ab980a841782, para 3]
Under the bill, fines could scale: $500 a day for failures that continue after conviction, or $1,000 per affected user or controlling person for due-diligence breaches. [S:e8c0a71f0cc5, s.80R(4)-(5)]
The consultation proposed dual CARF and CRS reporting of crypto proceeds for entities in both regimes. [S:275d5cc93a88, para 4.17]
All four VA intermediary regimes have conclusions; one bill is targeted for 2026, with no deeming arrangement. [S:c6df52e680de, Reply part (3)]; [S:6186c01c6649, para 31]; [S:01c5c5c4045f, para 63]
For dealing and custody, banks register with the SFC and the HKMA is frontline regulator. [S:7395a53cc85a, para 4]; [S:27d27650e820, para 1.10]
VA management will have no de minimis threshold, so even a small VA portion of a managed portfolio will need a licence or registration. [S:01c5c5c4045f, paras 32, 68]
Under the SFC framework, VATP perpetuals may take HKMA-regulated tokenised deposits as margin collateral. [S:49f642bdee28, 'Margin arrangements and loss allocation management']
The HKMA plans EnsembleTX central bank money settlement and 24/7 operation by around end-2026. [S:ef3648ff1610, para 50]
CMU OmniClear is to set up a digital asset platform in 2026 for digital bond issuance and settlement. [S:654fa5eba8cf, para 114]
C&ED aims to launch digital-asset transaction analytics (DATAS) by 2029. [S:ef3648ff1610, Annex (I) New Indicators, item 209]
The FATF's next VA/VASP update and a DeFi report are approved but not yet published. [S:43fd79de14c1, section (3)(e)]
mBridge leaves AML and sanctions screening to each bank, off the platform. [S:947fa49606ab, s.6.5.2, p.30]
The 2022 e-HKD policy paper said customer-facing institutions could be tasked with customer due diligence under a two-tier design. [S:3b42966a786e, Section 5.4, p.35]
The HKMA's e-HKD focus is now wholesale payments, to support tokenisation and cross-border payments. [S:6bd9e65817c4, para 4]
In Phase 2, commercial banks leaned slightly towards tokenised deposits rather than e-HKD. [S:bdefe7fc69d4, Executive Summary, p.2]
mBridge reached MVP in June 2024; the Government calls it part of Hong Kong's financial market infrastructure. [S:db56d97e2206, para 1]; [S:2ffb8727bb2f, Reply (4)]
There is no decision to issue a retail e-HKD. [S:d51dc8884c8a, 'Policy Stance and Three-Rail Approach']
The 2022 mBridge pilot ran on a centralised cloud in Hong Kong, and the report said holding data in a single cloud heightened privacy concerns. [S:947fa49606ab, s.5.1, p.16; s.7.1.3, p.33]
In Phase 2, zero-knowledge-proof privacy tools tested on public blockchains made transactions up to 320 times more costly in gas fees. [S:bdefe7fc69d4, Section 4 'Privacy', p.30]
ASPIRe is a roadmap; its initiatives take effect through separate SFC circulars and guidance, so track those. [S:cfe8a53186c3, para 5]; [S:089ec86e2407, para 2]
Delivered items so far include staking, shared order books, VA financing and professional-investor perpetuals. [S:36753b22e10a, para 2]; [S:f09e57feb89b, para 2]; [S:089ec86e2407, paras 2-3]
The SFC's Executive Director of Intermediaries called the roadmap-based approach essential to scaling Hong Kong's digital asset market. [S:089ec86e2407, para 5]

Outcome-based custody standards are still framed as something to explore; the SFC's August 2025 VATP custody circular took immediate effect. [S:d461c2db6af2, Pillar S, Initiative 3]; [S:562c0f8addce, 'Way forward', p.7]
The bill is not yet law. If passed, CARF duties start 1 January 2027 and amended CRS 1 January 2028. [S:d70ae2cbc9d1, Overview]; [S:e8c0a71f0cc5, Clause 1(3)-(4)]
A customer crypto exchange service run as a business, even as intermediary, can make the entity an RCASP. [S:e8c0a71f0cc5, s.50M]
Hong Kong committed to CARF in December 2024, with first data exchanges targeted from 2028. [S:ea81f92ea327, para 4]

Proposed fines can scale: a further $500 a day for some continuing offences after conviction, and for due-diligence offences the higher of a level 3 fine or $1,000 per affected user or controlling person. [S:e8c0a71f0cc5, s.80R(4)-(5)]
Sela and Aurum were research projects. Sela's report says it reflects no HKMA policy decision on an e-HKD. [S:d51dc8884c8a, 'Collaborative Projects']; [S:f9000467b0ee, Section 1, footnote 5, p.5]
About 80,000 e-CNY wallets had been registered by end-January 2026, with 18 Hong Kong banks supporting FPS top-ups. [S:062b0a1547b9, Reply (1)]
Under the 2026 Shanghai MoU, electronic bills of lading will be explored under Project Ensemble. [S:eb28508e5032, para 2]
Pilot e-CNY wallets do not allow person-to-person transfers and cap balances at RMB10,000. [S:08caafe0cfe7, Annex 2, pp.1-2]
No rules have been published yet for the platform or the Exchange Fund Bills tests; both are stated targets. [S:ef3648ff1610, para 35(ii), (iv)]
The platform is meant as a one-stop service for digital bond issuance and settlement. [S:ef3648ff1610, para 35(iv)]
The HKMA plans tests by end-2026 on tokenising Exchange Fund Bills, aimed at helping banks use more than $1.3 trillion of these bills round the clock. [S:ef3648ff1610, para 35(ii)]
A DLT platform has statutory finality only if the HKMA designates it; otherwise finality rests on contract. [S:a0b44be27c40, paras 37-38, p.15]
The grant is a subsidy. The HKMA reserves the absolute right to decide eligibility and the amount. [S:5a0563de8142, p.1]
Clients can recover half of eligible expenses, up to HK$2.5 million per issue, for at most two issues per issuer and its associates. [S:5a0563de8142, s.1, p.2]
The 2026-27 Budget says the HKMA will use the scheme to encourage more digital bond issues in Hong Kong. [S:654fa5eba8cf, para 97]
Using a DLT platform provided by an associate of the issuer rules out the Full Grant, leaving the Half Grant at most. [S:5a0563de8142, s.3, p.4]
The Evergreen report says existing SFO licensing and offering rules also apply to digital bonds. [S:a0b44be27c40, para 23, p.11]
Sixteen financial institutions arranged the HKMC deal. Investors could use existing CMU links to Euroclear and Clearstream, and settlement fell from T+5 to T+3. [S:6aa27ee8b400, paras 5, 8]
The Policy Address says Hong Kong-issued digital bonds took nearly half the global market from 2025 to mid-2026. [S:ef3648ff1610, para 35]

The Evergreen report notes that DLT platform capabilities are largely untested in financial markets and suggests continuity plans, including for migrating to another platform. [S:a0b44be27c40, para 47, p.17]

No decision exists to introduce an e-HKD. The 2022 paper saw distributing institutions as the ones that could handle customer due diligence. [S:d51dc8884c8a, 'Policy Stance and Three-Rail Approach']; [S:3b42966a786e, Section 5.4, p.35]
The HKMA's e-HKD focus is now wholesale payments, supporting tokenisation and cross-border settlement. [S:6bd9e65817c4, para 4]

The Government's November 2025 digital green bonds were the first digital bond offering worldwide to use e-HKD and e-CNY (the Mainland's digital renminbi) in settlement. [S:ac6cd085a325, 'Integration of digital money' paragraph]
In Phase 2, zero-knowledge proof privacy tools made transactions up to 320 times more expensive in gas fees (network transaction fees). [S:bdefe7fc69d4, Section 4 'Privacy', PDF p.34]

EnsembleTX is a pilot, not a rulebook. Customer tokenised deposits still fall under the HKMA tokenised-products circular, which expects discussion with the HKMA in advance. [S:8b67e8dc510f, para 1]; [S:b2719f3dcb37, footnote 1; 'Implementation', p.6]
The pilot starts with tokenised money market funds and real-time treasury uses, and the HKMA invites new real-value use cases for tokenised deposits. [S:8b67e8dc510f, paras 2 and 5]
The 2026 Policy Address says the HKMA plans to bring 24/7 operations and CBDC settlement to EnsembleTX by around end-2026. [S:ef3648ff1610, para 50]
Tokenised deposits cannot get stable retail deposit LCR treatment. If holders cannot always be identified, they count as other unsecured wholesale funding. [S:69600121310a, Annex 3 para 4, p.89]
On mBridge, AML and sanctions checks stay with each bank, off the platform. [S:947fa49606ab, s.6.5.2, p.30; s.7.2(d), p.35]
Participating Hong Kong banks set their own fees for mBridge payments. [S:2ffb8727bb2f, Reply (4)]
mBridge reached MVP in June 2024; the Government calls it part of Hong Kong's financial market infrastructure. [S:db56d97e2206, para 1]; [S:2ffb8727bb2f, Reply (4)]
The 2022 pilot ran on a centralised cloud in Hong Kong. The report says keeping data in one cloud raised privacy concerns. [S:947fa49606ab, s.5.1, p.16; s.7.1.3, p.33]
Government now says *digital assets*, but *virtual asset* is still the defined term in AMLO. [S:a29b51bffc6b, footnote 1]; [S:7395a53cc85a, Note]
The 2026 Policy Address says the SFC will promote trading of regulated stablecoins on licensed platforms and their use to settle tokenised money market funds. [S:ef3648ff1610, para 49(iii)]
The Government's stated 2026 target is one bill for VA dealing, custody, advisory and management licensing. [S:c6df52e680de, Reply part (3)]
Customs plans a digital-asset transaction analytics system by 2029, as part of its anti-money laundering big-data platform. [S:ef3648ff1610, Annex (I) New Indicators, item 209]

As an RI, we follow the HKMA RI circular; 26EC26 sets standards for VATPs and LCs. RIs are still reminded to notify both regulators in advance. [S:19d52ade6849, opening paragraph and fn 2, p.1]; [S:a0bd48559762, Implementation, p.9]

For Relevant-Stablecoin-only clients, no VA knowledge test and no VA exposure limit are needed. Offering those clients any other VA brings back the full rules. [S:a0bd48559762, para (3)(a)-(b) and fn 4, pp.4-5]
The Policy Address says the SFC will promote licensed-platform trading of regulated stablecoins, including for tokenised money market fund settlement. [S:ef3648ff1610, para 49(iii)]
Only coins issued under an HKMA licence qualify, and the HKMA register lists the licensees. [S:19d52ade6849, para 2]; [S:afb6cd0da6ff, para 4]

Only coins from licensed issuers may be offered to retail investors, and AIs are permitted offerors. The HKMA register lists who is licensed. [S:7b6c8dc63140, reply (1), para 1]; [S:afb6cd0da6ff, paras 4-5]
Two issuers hold licences effective 10 April 2026. The HKMA says any further licences will stay very limited in number. [S:270f1f7324ab, Register table]; [S:193316443831, 'Follow-up work', para 3]
An AI may apply to issue, and the financial-resources and business-activities criteria do not apply to it. [S:fe4baea8dd7d, para 3.2.1; fns 1, 8]

A licensee must give holders a right to redeem at par, and should process valid requests within one business day. Reserves should be held under trust arrangements with qualified custodians. [S:240be6833157, paras 2.5.2, 2.5.4, 3.3.1, 3.3.3]
Any supervisory flexibility in the Incubator is decided case by case and depends on how the bank manages trial risks. [S:fae36c380174, p.1 and footnote 2]

Six banks have launched tokenised deposit services through the Incubator, according to the HKMA. [S:418769c01edc, 'Supervisory Incubator for DLT – where traditional finance and tokenisation meets' section]
The HKMA's business-model circular says a bank's strategic plan may factor in small real-world trials through the Incubator. [S:3ec5b269b5dc, letter body, para 4]
The HKMA's DLT considerations say the board and senior management carry full responsibility for DLT adoption and its risks. [S:1884530ff235, Annex item 1]
Phase 1 changed no law; it confirmed flexibility and added Companies Registry FAQs on DLT registers. [S:279f10054c6e, paras 1, 6]
Phase 2 will explore electronic execution of tokenised bond issue documents, aimed at a more efficient and automated issuance process. [S:279f10054c6e, para 10]
The HKMA set up the TBEG to explore policy measures, market practices and innovations with industry. [S:fc3eb72031c6, paras 1-2]
Possession and transfer of tokenised instruments are topics for the phase 2 review, set for H2 2026. [S:279f10054c6e, paras 8, 11]
All four regimes have conclusions; one bill is targeted for 2026 and no deeming arrangement is planned. [S:c6df52e680de, Reply part (3)]; [S:6186c01c6649, para 31]; [S:01c5c5c4045f, para 63]
Each of the four activities will need a licence or registration once its regime starts, and VA management has no de minimis threshold. [S:01c5c5c4045f, paras 32, 63]
Commencement dates are not set; the Government and SFC will weigh how long the market needs to adjust. [S:6186c01c6649, para 32]; [S:01c5c5c4045f, para 64]
Under the dealing regime, the SFC will require client VAs to be held with SFC-regulated custodians. [S:6186c01c6649, para 26]

timeline.ev: HKMA starts its e-HKD journey with Project LionRock, a wholesale proof of concept with the three note-issuing banks.
SFC says tokens from an initial coin offering may be securities under the SFO.
HKMA publishes its second DLT whitepaper (first in 2016).
HKMA keynote argues that crypto-currencies such as Bitcoin fail the functions of money and calls them crypto-assets.
SFC sets standards for VA portfolio managers and fund distributors; oversight covers portfolios aiming to put 10% or more in VAs.
HKMA and Bank of Thailand start Inthanon-LionRock with ten banks.
SFC position paper sets opt-in licensing for platforms trading security tokens, with 98% cold storage.
HKMA circular on ML/TF risks of VAs and VASPs replaces the 2014 letters.
HKMA and Bank of Thailand publish the Inthanon-LionRock report.
FSTB opens AML consultation proposing VASP licensing (closed 31 Jan 2021).
SFC licenses the first VATP, for professional investors only.
The People's Bank of China Digital Currency Institute and the Central Bank of the UAE join; project renamed m-CBDC Bridge.
FSTB conclusions: VA exchanges to be SFC-licensed, initially professional investors only.
HKMA launches Fintech 2025, including an e-HKD study.
Retail e-HKD study begins.
Project Genesis: tokenised green bond proof of concept with the BIS Innovation Hub.
mBridge interim report on faster, cheaper cross-border payments.
e-HKD technical whitepaper explores a two-tier architecture; the HKMA says it is not a blueprint.
HKMA discussion paper on crypto-assets and stablecoins (comments to 31 Mar 2022).
HKMA sets its approach to AIs' interface with VAs and VASPs.
First SFC–HKMA joint circular on VA activities.
e-HKD policy and design paper (comments to 27 May 2022).
Six-week mBridge real-value pilot begins (to 23 Sep 2022).
'e-HKD: Charting the Next Steps' sets the three-rail approach.
mBridge pilot report: 20 banks in four jurisdictions, over 160 transactions, more than HK$171 million.
Project Aurum report on a two-tier retail CBDC prototype.
Policy Statement on VAs adopts 'same activity, same risks, same regulation'.
e-HKD Pilot Programme launched.
LegCo passes AMLO amendments creating VASP licensing, in force from 1 June 2023.
HKMA circulates the Basel prudential standard for cryptoasset exposures.
HKMA stablecoin consultation conclusion proposes mandatory licensing for key stablecoin activities.
HK$800 million tokenised government green bond offered.
SFC consults on VATP rules, including retail access.
e-HKD pilots start with 16 firms.
SFC VATP conclusions allow retail access with safeguards.
Revised HKMA AML/CFT Guideline for AIs, with a HK$8,000 VA transfer threshold.
AMLO VATP licensing regime and VATP Guidelines take effect.
HKMA report on bond tokenisation (Project Evergreen).
Project Sela report published.
timeline.by: HKMA + Bank of Israel + BIS Innovation Hub

timeline.ev: SFC states that no JPEX group entity is licensed by it or has applied for a licence.
SFC publishes lists of VATPs, including applicants, and a suspicious VATPs list.
Revised joint circular; HKMA forms CBDC Expert Group.
e-HKD Phase 1 report and mBridge update.
SFC tokenised-securities circular replaces the 2019 STO statement.
Current joint circular issued; SFC circular on VA funds.
Stablecoin issuer consultation (to 29 Feb 2024).
HKMA CP 24.01 on cryptoasset exposures (comments to 6 May 2024).
About HK$6 billion multi-currency digital green bonds offered.
VA OTC licensing consultation (Customs-run).
HKMA custody standards and tokenised-products circulars (the custody guidance was replaced on 27 May 2026).
Deadline for pre-existing VATPs to file a licence application to qualify for deeming.
HKMA unveils Project Ensemble.
Stablecoin issuer sandbox launched.
e-HKD Phase 2 announced.
HKMA DLT risk-management considerations.
Ensemble Architecture Community formed.
Cross-boundary e-CNY pilot expanded.
From this date, VATPs in Hong Kong must be SFC-licensed or deemed-to-be-licensed; the non-contravention period is over.
mBridge reaches MVP; Saudi Central Bank joins as a full participant.
Banque de France and HKMA announce wholesale CBDC collaboration under a new MoU, linking the Banque de France's DL3S platform with the Ensemble Sandbox.
Stablecoin consultation conclusions (108 submissions).
Ensemble Sandbox launched.
e-HKD Phase 2 starts; project becomes e-HKD+.
CMU OmniClear Limited established.
Tie-ups with Banco Central do Brasil (Drex) and Bank of Thailand (Project San).
Digital Bond Grant Scheme launched.
Stablecoins Bill gazetted (First Reading 18 Dec 2024).
Hong Kong commits to CARF.
SFC revamps VATP licensing with conditional licences.
HKMA Supervisory Incubator for DLT launched.
HKMA soft-consults the banking associations on cryptoasset capital rules, intending them to apply from 1 Jan 2026.
SFC publishes the ASPIRe roadmap.
HKMA and SFC circulars on staking.
LegCo passes the Stablecoins Bill.
Policy Statement 2.0 (LEAP).
VA dealing and custodian consultations (to 29 Aug 2025).
Cryptoasset capital, disclosure and exposure-limit rules gazetted.
Stablecoins Ordinance and HKMA stablecoin guidelines take effect.
HKMA issues SB-1 version 4.
Supplemental joint circular lets LCs and RIs offer staking and trade through SFC-licensed platforms' off-platform services.
Government says mBridge is part of Hong Kong's financial market infrastructure.
e-HKD Phase 2 report; wholesale uses prioritised.
SFC shared-liquidity and product-expansion circulars; HKMA Fintech 2030.
About HK$10 billion digital green bonds, the first digital bond offering to use e-HKD and e-CNY in settlement.
EnsembleTX pilot launched.
CRP-1 issued, effective 1 Jan 2026.
CARF and amended CRS consultation (to 6 Feb 2026).
Dealing and custodian conclusions; advisory and management consultation.
Basel cryptoasset rules and CRP-1 take effect.
SFC lets VA brokers offer VA margin financing, sets a framework for VATP perpetual contracts for professional investors, and permits affiliated market makers.
Budget states plans for a 2026 bill on VA dealing and custodian licensing, a CARF amendment bill in the first half of 2026, and a CMU OmniClear digital asset platform.
HKMA, Shanghai Data Bureau and National Technology Innovation Center for Blockchain sign MoU on digitised cargo trade and finance.
HKMA expects each AI's board to endorse, within six months, a strategic business plan for digital transformation.
First two stablecoin issuer licences granted.
SFC framework to pilot secondary trading of tokenised SFC-authorised products.
CARF bill gazetted; introduced into LegCo on 3 Jun 2026.
VA advisory and management conclusions.
HKMA updated custody guidance, RI Relevant Stablecoin circular and VA financing guidance; SFC Relevant Stablecoin circular.
SFC list shows 13 licensed VATPs.
HKMA clarifies CRP-1 para 2.6.4 with immediate effect.
HKMA convenes Tokenised Bond Expert Group.
FSTB and HKMA: first-phase review finds the law flexible enough for tokenised bond issuance; next phase to start in the second half of 2026.
SFC requires phishing-resistant login and device binding for VATPs and internet brokers within 12 months.
Policy Address: HKMA to test tokenised Exchange Fund Bills by year-end, and plans to bring CBDC settlement and round-the-clock operation to EnsembleTX by around end-2026.

glossary.def: A bank or other institution authorised by the HKMA. The HKMA's AML/CFT Guideline is issued under s.7 of the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Ordinance (AMLO) and s.7(3) of the Banking Ordinance, and sets the standards AIs, including RIs, should meet.
